### NVDA — NVIDIA | **Bullish**
> Reason: Landmark AI acquisition + blowout Q2 results signal continued dominance.

- **Q2 FY2027 Earnings**: Revenue of **$96.2 billion**, up 18% QoQ and **106% YoY**. Continues the streak of triple-digit growth.
- **Dividend**: Next quarterly cash dividend of **$0.25/share** payable Oct 1, 2026 to shareholders of record Sep 10.

- New board member also appointed.
